What needs to be confirmed for your calendar

Configured AI can support booking on eligible channels, including WhatsApp, alongside staff-created appointments. Your account’s connections and simultaneous booking behaviour need to be verified. Test both paths, conflict calendars, buffers, time zones, capacity and manual overrides before relying on shared availability.

External calendar sync can depend on provider settings and timing. No blanket promise of instant synchronisation or zero double bookings is made. AI booking does not automatically collect a payment.

The full appointment journey

Less back-and-forth.
A clearer next step.

Booking is one part of the relationship. Keep preparation, changes and follow-up visible too.

Start with a useful enquiry

Capture the requested service, location and suitable contact details. Use approved information for routine questions and pass exceptions to a person.

Offer an available time

Use the configured calendar or booking link, with the right service, staff, duration and capacity rules. Confirm the customer’s chosen slot.

Make confirmation clear

Share the agreed time, location and preparation details through a supported channel. Set expectations for changes and any terms before booking.

Use relevant reminders

Configure reminder timing and messages for the service. Delivery, customer permissions, provider rules and usage charges apply.

Record what happened

Keep attended, cancelled and no-show statuses accurate. A status change should lead to the right next action, not an automatic assumption.

Continue after the visit

Where appropriate, connect a quotation, review invitation or future visit to the customer record. Respect communication preferences.

When plans change

Different situations.
Different follow-through.

A reschedule, a cancellation and a missed appointment need different responses. Explore the three examples.

01 / Rescheduling

Keep the booking, change the time.

Check a suitable available alternative, update the original appointment and send the agreed confirmation. Avoid leaving a duplicate booking behind.
